name: bigcursor-workspace
description: Bigcursor helps make browser automation videos easier to understand. Add it to your project and you'll get Screen Studio style large cursors and keyboard presses that look like a user using your product.

scripts.example:playwright: bun run --cwd packages/bigcursor build && node examples/record-demo.mjs
scripts.example:playwright:headful: bun run --cwd packages/bigcursor build && node examples/record-demo.mjs --headful
scripts.pack:check: bun run --cwd packages/bigcursor build && node scripts/pack-check.mjs
scripts.test:package: bun run --cwd packages/bigcursor build && node scripts/pack-check.mjs --record
